# Phase 0 — Verified Architecture Inventory
*Generated by static analysis. Every claim verified against actual source.*

## Real Runtime Call Graph (what actually executes on a chat turn)

```
User sends message
  └─► ChatViewModel.sendMessage()           [3,277 LOC god class]
        ├─► RagRetriever.buildContextBlock() [REAL — Room DB query]
        ├─► HybridOrchestrator.execute()     [REAL — every message]
        │     ├─► RuntimeRouter.route()      [LOCAL / CLOUD decision]
        │     ├─► LocalLlamaBackend          [JNI → llama.cpp]
        │     └─► CloudBackend              [HTTP SSE, RetryPolicy]
        ├─► SubAgentRegistry.route()         [REAL — keyword scoring, not LLM]
        │     └─► SubAgent.execute()         [Flow<AgentEvent>]
        │           ├─► CodingAgent          DELEGATION SHELL — emits Delegate("llm_backend")
        │           ├─► ResearchAgent        DELEGATION SHELL
        │           ├─► MediaGenerationAgent DELEGATION SHELL
        │           ├─► DocumentProcessorAgent DELEGATION SHELL
        │           ├─► MemoryAgent          DELEGATION SHELL
        │           ├─► ProductivityAgent    DELEGATION SHELL
        │           ├─► LocalBrowserOperator REAL (OkHttp fetch + DOM strip)
        │           ├─► CloudBrowserAgent    REAL (OkHttp fetch + DOM strip)
        │           └─► AndroidAgent         REAL (AccessibilityExecutionEngine)
        ├─► cognitiveLoop.process(BrainInput, llmResponse) [POST-HOC, not pre-planning]
        │     └─► UCL.process() → planGenerator.createActionPlanFromLLM(llmResponse)
        │           └─► executeActionPlan()  [CommandRouter, not DAG]
        └─► TokenAccountant.recordSuccess()
```

## Verified Dual Stack Problem

**Legacy:** `ai/agent/` — AgentController, TaskPlanner, TaskExecutor, Task, TaskStep, AgentResult, AgentWorker, trace/*
**Modern:** `agent/` — ProductionAgentOrchestrator, SubAgentRegistry, UnifiedCognitiveLoop, TypedPlanGraph

**Real situation:** `AgentController` is used by `AgentService` which is used by `AgentExecutionPipeline`. None of these are in the live chat path. `AgentWorker` (legacy) IS active — runs every 2h, checks GitHub/Gmail via `ToolExecutor`. It is real but misplaced (uses legacy stack unnecessarily).

## Verified Sandbox Theatre

`SandboxExecutor.TaskType`:
- `KOTLIN_SCRIPT` → returns `ExecutionResult.UnsupportedOnDevice`
- `PYTHON_SCRIPT` → returns `ExecutionResult.UnsupportedOnDevice`
- `SHELL_COMMAND` → real, but allowlist = `ls cat echo mkdir cp mv rm find grep sed awk head tail wc sort uniq git zip unzip tar`
- `FILE_WRITE` / `FILE_READ` → real

**Verdict:** The "code execution sandbox" cannot execute code. Only file I/O and POSIX inspection tools work.

## Verified ServiceLocator Scale

104 `by lazy` / assignment lines. No DI graph, no scoped lifetimes, no test injection surface.

## UCL Architecture Confirmed

`UCL.process(BrainInput, llmResponse)` is the **legacy path** — it takes an already-generated LLM response, creates an action plan from it (pattern matching), and executes via `CommandRouter`. No planning, no tool-loop, no observation injection.

`UCL.executeGraph(TypedPlanGraph)` is the **new path** — has quality gate, parallel-wave execution, reflection, adaptation. **Zero non-test callers.** It is the most well-engineered piece of dead code in the repo.

## Production-Grade Pieces Worth Preserving

1. `LlamaManager` — session IDs, generation IDs, KV reconcile, full-reset state machine (~1,973 LOC, real production engineering)
2. `UCL.executeGraph` — parallel-wave DAG, quality gate, reflection, workspace snapshots (340 LOC dead but architecturally correct)
3. `TypedPlanGraph` — typed node I/O contracts, dependency tracking, conditional edges
4. `ScopedPermissionRegistry` — per-agent capability gating (good security concept)
5. `AccessibilityScopePolicy` — package denylist (added this session, correct)
6. `RetryPolicy` + `NetworkGuard` — production-grade cloud resilience
